GlobalRankingEntry.title: Global Ranking Entry
GlobalRankingEntry.description: Public cultivation leaderboard record submitted by a player through the periodic Global Ranking Portal. Contains zero PII.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Public cultivator callsign displayed on the Global Ranking stele.

score.description: Best or submitted run score (0 to 100000000).

level.description: Cultivation stage level from 1 (Valley Hatchling) to 12 (Ascended Human).

xp.description: Cumulative Essence XP earned across the ascension journey.

stageTitle.description: Cultivation stage title (e.g., Valley Hatchling, Sovereign Dragon, Ascended Human).

realmName.description: Cultivation realm tier (e.g., Dou Zhe, Dou Ling, Dou Di).

shrinesConquered.description: Number of Trial Peak Shrines conquered (0 to 12).

soulsCollected.description: Number of Soul Fragments recovered from Portal Trials (0 to 14).

bestiaryCount.description: Number of Bestiary species cataloged (0 to 20).

isHuman.description: Whether the cultivator has achieved Ascended Human form (Level 12).

biome.description: Biome active when the record was inscribed.

weather.description: Climate difficulty active when the record was inscribed.

speedPreset.description: Speed difficulty preset active when inscribed.

submissionsCount.description: Total number of portal inscriptions submitted by this cultivator.

portalWave.description: Global Ranking Portal manifestation wave number during inscription.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cultivator first inscribed on the Global Ranking stele.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest cultivation inscription.

/globalRankings/{userId}.description: Public Global Ranking leaderboard documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID. Any player may read bounded top entries to compare cultivation progress; only the verified owner may create, update, or remove their own record.
